mandatorySafetyRules.statement: Follow AGENTS.md and the task-relevant canonical document. This manifest indexes policy; it does not override runtime permissions or user instructions.

validationPolicy.notes: Project commands live in docs/governance/project-gates.json. Agent activation additionally requires npm run eval:verify.

runtimeExecutionPolicy: Native permissions and explicit user instructions take precedence; see AGENTS.md.
completionAudit: See docs/PLANS.md for closeout and evidence.

improveBeforeRearchitecture: Keep current state bounded and replace obsolete facts.
doNotAddYet: Do not duplicate policy or treat chat history as current product state.
escalateWhen: Verify task-relevant source when current docs conflict.
memoryPosture.safeRule: Current facts and remaining work stay compact, explicit, and linked to their owners.

gitSafetyContract.notes: See docs/design-docs/GIT-SAFETY.md. Preserve unrelated edits and index entries.
